draft: Clinician and native Dari review pending
intro: Follow her interests. Accept pictures, gestures, words and refusal. There is no pressure to speak.
flexible: Repeat, pause or skip. This is a flexible plan, not a deadline.
notScore: Activity completion is not a measure of the child’s ability.
promise: Respond to communication. Never withhold water, food, comfort or a break to obtain speech or a picture tap.
choose: What would you like to say?
boardIntro: Point, tap, gesture or speak. All are welcome.
noAudio: No recording for this card yet. The picture still communicates.
audioFail: Sound unavailable. You can still use the pictures.
saveFail: Could not save. Your change has not been stored; try again or export existing records.
badPass: Could not unlock. Check the passphrase and try again.
passMismatch: Use matching passphrases of at least 12 characters.
consent: I am the parent/legal guardian, or have their permission to keep these records on this device.
consentInfo: Optional records and voice clips are encrypted in this browser. Nothing is uploaded. No name, birth date or diagnosis is required. Clearing browser data can erase everything. Forgotten passphrases cannot be recovered. Use a private, protected device.
logoutNote: Locks after five minutes of inactivity or when the app is hidden. Pictures remain available; unlock to use private recordings.
qaIntro: Numbered questions for caregivers. Answers do not assess the child and are not stored or scored.
observationsIntro: Describe a functional communication moment. These are caregiver reports, not diagnostic results. No response is not failure.
checkpointIntro: Review comfort, communication across settings and useful supports with a qualified professional where available. These are review dates, not speech deadlines.
reviewPrompt: What is easier? What remains difficult? What support should change? Include her preferences.
exportWarn: This export is readable, not encrypted, and excludes voice recordings. Keep it private; share only by choice.
voiceIntro: Record a familiar adult’s voice. Keep clips short. Listen, then approve before the child hears them. Recordings are separate for each language.
nativePending: No professionally reviewed native Dari pack is supplied yet. Personal caregiver clips are not clinician-reviewed. Persian TTS is never substituted.
approve: I listened: approve for this card
micConsent: I have the speaker’s permission to record and store their voice locally. Do not record the child.
micFail: Microphone unavailable or permission denied. Use HTTPS/localhost and allow microphone access in browser settings. Pictures still work.
tts: Allow available on-device US English voice
ttsInfo: Only local en-US voices are used. Availability varies by device. Dari always uses an approved recording.
scopeNote: Educational support, not diagnosis or treatment. No clinical screening instruments are included. These organizations have not endorsed this app.
ageNote: WHO CST was designed for ages 2–9. This 11-year-old pilot needs professional age and context adaptation.
analyticsInfo: Off by default. Counts only unlocked app sessions and microphone setup errors; no card choices, answers, notes, identifiers or external analytics. Turning off clears counters.
erase: Erase all private records and recordings
eraseConfirm: Permanently erase private records and recordings on this browser?
restoreWarn: Restore replaces this browser’s private records after the backup passphrase is verified.
restoreFail: Invalid backup, wrong passphrase, or unsupported version. Nothing was replaced.
offlineWait: Offline setup pending; connect once and reload before travelling.
install: Install: use your browser menu → Install app / Add to Home Screen.
storageYes: Persistent storage granted. Backups are still important.
storageNo: Persistent storage was not granted. Keep an encrypted backup.
repeat: Repeatable draft activities; not 180 distinct clinical lessons.
pause: Pause whenever she shows discomfort or refuses.
recordLimit: Recording limit reached (2 MB). Try a shorter clip.
unsupported: Secure storage is unavailable in this browser. The picture board remains available without saving.
quickActions: What would you like to do?
lessonActionHint: Read the steps, choose a day, and mark your activity complete.
boardActionHint: Open large picture cards for choices, needs and refusal.
observeActionHint: Record a communication moment and the support offered.
voiceActionHint: Record, listen and approve a familiar adult voice.
qaActionHint: Explore numbered questions and practical answers.
progressActionHint: Review observations, checkpoints and progress exports.
checkpointActionHint: Review useful supports and decide what to keep or adjust.
startIntro: Tap Start. Follow one instruction, then tap Next. You can stop at any time.
dayOneHint: About 9 minutes of activities + two optional 5-minute breaks
finishBody: You have reached the end of today’s guide. No extra practice is required by the app. Pictures remain available all day.
saveOptional: Saving is optional. Set up private storage or unlock it to keep a record.
guideNote: No spoken answer or eye contact is required. Stop or pause whenever your child wants.
day-one: Day 1 · Notice how your child communicates
timeNote: Example timings for planning, not a therapy prescription. Stop sooner, take longer breaks, or do just one task.
breakBody: Pause the activity. Offer quiet, movement or something she enjoys. Keep her communication pictures available. Continue only when you both want to.
timerDone: Time is up. Pause or finish whenever you want.
earlyBody: You stopped early, and that is okay. No activity completion has been recorded. You can return to the guide when it suits you.
videoNote: These illustrated demonstrations work offline. Reviewed instructional videos and native Dari narration are not available yet.
shortSession: One task is enough to start.
handOver: Hand over the tablet if she wants. She can use pictures to communicate, explore them, or stop.
childExploreHint: Touch a picture. You can say no or take a break.
homeTitle: A little guidance. A meaningful day.
homeIntro: One small step at a time. We will show you what to do and what to say. Pause or finish whenever you need.
homeActivityHint: Three short activities. One instruction on each screen, with optional breaks.
homePathHint: Explore the draft starting activities. Personalized recommendations are not implemented yet.
planIntro: A flexible path, not a deadline.
planDraft: Day 1 has guided demonstrations. The full first-week and six-month curriculum, onboarding and professional review are still pending.
planFirstHint: Three short activities with demonstrations, a child’s turn and optional breaks.
planRepeatHint: The existing planner repeats 14 draft modules across 180 slots. These are not 180 unique lessons or an individualized prescription.
planReviewHint: With consent, save observations and discuss everyday examples with a qualified professional. Private records require your passphrase.
gardenHint: Touch a plant and see it change. You can stop whenever you want.
gardenNote: Optional play. No scores, tests or saved tap history.
libraryIntro: 14 draft activities for everyday communication. Choose one, repeat a favourite, or take a break. These are options—not a daily checklist.
photoScope: Photographic examples are illustrative, not clinical documentation. Familiar objects and settings may differ between families.
tryTogether: Offer the picture board if she wants it. Show one picture yourself, then give her time. A gesture, refusal or no response is okay.
returnHint: Return using “Back to parent”. Then choose a break or finish. No tap or spoken answer is required.
weekIntro: Follow one instruction at a time. Short practice is enough; pause whenever you need.
weekReviewFirst: First, revisit the previous session. Then choose whether to continue or repeat.
weekTomorrow: On your next visit on a later day, start with a short review. No more work is required today.
weekReflect: Review your notes and discuss useful next goals with a qualified professional. You can repeat familiar activities.
weekBegin: Start with a familiar activity. This is practice, not a test.
weekSaved: Progress is saved in your encrypted information on this device.
weekGuest: Preview mode: progress lasts only until this page reloads. Unlock or set up private storage to keep your place.
weekSessionDone: Session finished · not a mastery score
weekDraft: Draft educational content · clinical and native Dari reviews pending. This is not a clinical assessment.
weekSetupHint: These answers provide context, not a diagnosis or level. The first week is shared practice; it is not automatically prescribed from these answers.
week_communication: How does the child communicate now?
week_interest: What does the child often enjoy?
weekReviewHint: Offer it briefly if welcome. What did you notice? “Not tried” is a valid answer.
weekRespect: She declined. Respect that message. You can rest, repeat another time, or continue only if welcome.
weekNoScore: This records what you noticed, not ability or mastery. No response is required.
weekRestHint: Put the screen aside and offer rest. Return when comfortable, or finish for today.
weekOutcome_supported: Communicated with support or a demonstration
weekReturn: Welcome back. Your place is saved.
weekLockedHint: Unlock this device’s private records to continue your learning sessions. Your saved day is hidden while locked.
